title: Shared quotient-remainder categorical tables with field Mirror views
hypothesis: For MovieLens 1M binary preference prediction, one shared QR factor pair with per-role Givens views will preserve independent-QR quality while using at least 10% fewer complete bytes, improve AUC by at least 0.003 over the best shared-QR non-Mirror control on both fresh seeds, and retain at least 80% of shared-QR inference throughput.
scope: MovieLens 1M explicit ratings >=4 binary preference screen. It is not a Criteo CTR reproduction.
physical_object: One pair of quotient/remainder embedding tables shared by user and item roles, plus the common GMF prediction head.
mirror_coordinate: Sixteen learned Givens angles per role applied to the shared QR composed embedding.
logical_multiplicity: Two role-specific embedding functions from one shared physical QR factor pair.
prior_art_delta: PA339 QR composes two complementary table lookups by elementwise multiplication and produces unique category index pairs. This experiment asks whether a small role view recovers utility when QR factors are shared across the user and item fields.

dataset.name: GroupLens MovieLens 1M
dataset.citation: F. Maxwell Harper and Joseph A. Konstan. 2015. The MovieLens Datasets: History and Context. ACM TiiS 5(4), Article 19. DOI 10.1145/2827872.
dataset.access_terms: Research use only; cite Harper and Konstan (2015); no redistribution; no commercial/revenue-bearing use without GroupLens permission.
dataset.task_label: rating >=4 is positive; ratings 1-3 are negative
dataset.previous_audit_exclusion: Exclude pairs in either prior audit: SHA256(user_id:item_id) modulo 10 equals 9 (MA-1063), or among the remainder SHA256(MA-1064:user_id:item_id) modulo 10 equals 9 (MA-1064).
dataset.new_split: Among remaining pairs, SHA256(MA-1065:user_id:item_id) modulo 10: 0-7 train, 8 dev, 9 fresh audit. Pair IDs are not persisted.

shared_qr.mapping: global_id user=(user_id-1); item=6040+(item_id-1); remainder=global_id mod 101; quotient=global_id div 101; composed vector is W_rem[remainder] elementwise-multiplied by W_quo[quotient]

independent_qr.composition: quotient and remainder lookups combined by elementwise multiplication

hash_control.mapping: stable multiplicative hash of combined global ID

model.head: linear GMF logit over elementwise product of user and item embeddings
model.optimizer: Adam lr=0.001, weight_decay=1e-6, batch=4096, CPU float32, one Torch thread

controls: Independent full-cardinality user/item embedding tables (upper control)
Independent per-role native QR tables (PA339 control)
One shared QR factor pair, no role view
One shared QR factor pair plus matched 16-value paired diagonal gains per role
One shared QR factor pair plus 32-channel FiLM per role
One shared QR factor pair plus 16-angle Givens Mirror per role
One 200-row shared hash table (same approximate storage as shared QR)

development.selection: Train methods through epoch 3; choose method-specific epoch by mean development logloss across both seeds.
development.metrics: primary binary AUC; secondary logloss; collision count by categorical mapping
development.tuning_boundary: Development only; all prior audit pairs are excluded.

fresh.training_data: Frozen training partition; fresh initialization per seed.
fresh.audit_data: Frozen 10% split among previously unscored pairs.

success_gate: Both fresh seeds: shared-QR+Mirror AUC >= best shared-QR non-Mirror control +0.003; overall logloss <= independent QR +0.002; complete payload <=90% of independent QR; CPU throughput >=80% of shared QR no-view.
failure_gate: Mirror misses any fresh quality/storage/throughput gate, or matched diagonal/FiLM is within 0.003 AUC on both seeds.

paid_objects: full independent tables for upper control

boundaries: One dataset and one deterministic fresh split; two training seeds are not independent data worlds.
The two previously scored MA-1063/1064 audit partitions are excluded from all MA-1065 splits.
QR complementarity prevents index-pair collisions, but learned embeddings can still be functionally redundant.
A small Mirror×roles combination count is not called independent capacity.
This is a compact CPU screen, not official QR-Rec, Criteo CTR, GPU or production evidence.
Do not redistribute MovieLens data or use it commercially without permission.
